title: “The Argument” podcast, ad free: Why is Gen Z so mad?
contentHtml:
Young people today are dealing with a historically poor economy — or at least that’s what they appear to believe. To help Matt and Jerusalem understand why 4.1 percent unemployment and 3.7 percent inflation feel like the worst economy of all time, economics commentator and Gen Z whisperer Kyla Scanlon joined “The Argument” podcast for our latest episode…
